architectural_fit.evidence:
Read parseMarkdownBlock.ts (416 lines):
  - Two-pass def collection: extractDefinitions (line 364) sweeps raw lines, captures LINK_DEF_RE matches into linkDefs and FOOTNOTE_DEF_RE matches into footnoteRawDefs, strips both from bodyLines. Footnote bodies are then parsed to spans in two passes (lines 378-384) so cross-footnote references resolve.
  - parseMarkdownBlock (top-level, line 406) does the def extraction; parseMarkdownBlockWithDefs (recursive helper, line 391) re-enters with caller-supplied defs so blockquote inner blocks (line 104) and details inner blocks (line 336) inherit message-global defs.
  - BlockDefs threaded through ALL parseMarkdownSpans call sites: header (151), unordered list (78), task list (68), numbered list (256), blockquote (104 via collectBlockquote), details summary (320), text (356), details body (336 recursive).
  - tryDetailsBlock (327) recognizes <details (open)?> via DETAILS_OPEN_RE (294) honoring open attribute; matches <summary>...</summary> via SUMMARY_LINE_RE (295); body lines until </details> via findDetailsClose (297). Falls through to text rendering (returns false) when </details> missing — R4 defense.
  - parseMarkdown returns ParsedMarkdown shape (parseMarkdown.ts:91-93): MarkdownBlock[] with non-enumerable footnotes + linkDefs grafted via Object.defineProperty at parseMarkdownBlock.ts:409-414. Test at line 233 reads result.footnotes.has('1') successfully → graft works at runtime.
architectural_fit.notes: Type cast `as ParsedMarkdown` is honest because the runtime grafting actually occurs immediately before return. No lying type. Shape additive: existing callers that destructure as MarkdownBlock[] are unaffected.
